chunks: Muhammad ibn Muhammad 'Isam al-Kulayni narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Muhammad, known as 'Allan, narrated to us, saying: Abu Hamid Imran ibn Musa ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn al-Qasim al-Raqqam, from al-Qasim ibn Muslim, from his brother Abd al-Aziz ibn Muslim, who said: I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorified is He:
«They forgot Allah, so He forgot them»

He said: Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, does not forget nor does He omit, but rather only the created, transient creature forgets and omits. Do you not hear Him, Exalted and Glorified is He, say: «And your Lord has never been forgetful»? Rather, He only rewards he who forgot Him and forgot the meeting of His Day by making them forget themselves, as He, Exalted and Glorified is He, said: «And do not be like those who forgot Allah, to which He made them forget themselves. They are the sinful.» And His saying, Exalted and Glorified is He: «So, today We will forget them like how they forgot the meeting of this day of theirs», meaning: We abandon them like how they abandoned preparation for the meeting of this day of theirs.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He 'forgot' those who forgot Him?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies that divine 'forgetting' (nasa) in the Quran is a metaphor for abandonment or retributive consequence rather than literal cognitive lapse, affirming Allah's perfection against human attributes of heedlessness. He links the verse 'they forgot Allah, so He forgot them' to the internal state of self-forgetting, where neglect of the Creator leads to neglect of one's own soul and preparation for the Hereafter. This interpretation aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of distinguishing between divine essence and human experience, emphasizing that God's 'forgetting' is an active act of leaving creatures to their chosen state of spiritual neglect.

en.basel-kadem: 5.	We were told by Muhammed bin Muhammed bin ‘Isam al-Kulayni, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Ya’qub al-Kulayni, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Muhammed, known as ‘Allan, that he said: We were told by Abu Hamid, Imran bin Musa bin Ibrahim, from Hussain bin Qasim al-Raqqam, from Qasim bin Muslim, from his brother, Abdul-Aziz bin Muslim, that he said: I asked al-Rida, peace be upon him, about the saying of Allah, Glorious and Exalted is He:
«They forgot Allah, and so He forgot them» [9:67]

so he said: Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, does not forget, nor does He omit, but rather, only the made creature forgets and omits. Do you not hear Him, Exalted and Glorious is He, say: «And your Lord has never been forgetful» [19:64]? Rather, He only rewards he who forgot him and forgot the meeting of His Day by making them forget themselves, like how He, Exalted and Glorious is He, said: «And do not be like those who forgot Allah, to which He made them forget themselves. They are the sinful.» [59:19] As well as His saying, Exalted and Glorious is He: «So, today We will forget them like how they forgot the meeting of this day of theirs.» [7:51] Meaning: We abandon them like how they abandoned preparation to this day of theirs.
